The reasons for the backwardness of the western

The status of China's western region has been as high as the eastern region to being declining, both natural and social.

Over the past five thousand years, China's climate has become increasingly hard

Drought, which is particularly prominent in the northwest region. The Yellow River Basin at the mid-latitude of the Ming and Qing dynasties was generally dry and cold. The trend was particularly obvious in the northwest region, with water resources particularly lacking, which had a great impact on the agricultural economy and industrial economy, especially on the Futong agricultural and animal husbandry economy. The prosperity of the Silk Road in the Han Dynasty and the prosperity of the Longyou Road in the Tang Dynasty were related to the relatively humid climate and abundant river water at that time. When these conditions deteriorated, the Silk Road declined.

In addition: the impact of inland location and marine location on social and economic development is obvious. The economic development has reached a certain level. The coastal economy enjoys unique advantages in transportation and resources. In the Tang and Song dynasties, traffic was blocked and information was not effective. Land resources were not ineffective.

What is the significance of developing the West?

As early as the 1950s, Mao Zedong emphasized in the famous (On the Ten Major Relations) that we must handle the relationship between coastal industries and mainland industries well. Deng Xiaoping proposed the strategic thinking of [two overall situations]: one overall situation] that coastal areas accelerate opening up to the outside world and develop first faster. The mainland should take into account this overall situation; the other [the overall situation] is that coastal areas develop to a certain period of time and put more efforts to help the mainland development. Zhanhai areas should also take into account this overall situation.

Since Jiang Zemin took office, he has also attached great importance to this major issue of overall significance and clearly stated that the implementation of the Western Development is a national development.

The growth rate of GDP in western China was once 0.44% higher than that of the eastern region in the 30 years after the founding of New China, thus gradually narrowing the economic development gap between the eastern and western regions. In 1978, the average annual income difference between the two regions was only about 200 yuan, but then in the 20 years of reform and opening up, the average annual growth rate in the eastern and western regions was more than four percentage points higher than that of the western region, 600 yuan, and nearly three times higher than that of the western region. The Chinese leadership had long foreseeed the situation of differences between the eastern and western regions. When the top leaders of the Communist Party of China decided to take the road of reform and opening up, they realized that it was impossible to move forward together, so they could only let the eastern coastal areas with better conditions go first.

From now on, it will be a major strategic task for the Party and the country. At the turn of the century, the CCP made a strategic decision on the implementation of the Western Development. It is a great strategy for China's modernization construction in the 21st century. It has great practical significance. Implementing the Western Development Strategy. This is also an important step in implementing the strategic concept of Deng Xiaoping. The western region of China has a vast territory, abundant resources and huge market potential.
